description: Connects one Google Business Profile location so Sergio reads its reviews, as the Google Business Profile card does after the owner signs in with Google: pick the location Sergio should read by its Google resource name (locationName, like locations/123, from the card's location list). Sets that account's review notifications at Sergio; nothing on the profile changes. The owner must already have signed in with Google on that card. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; the same location is one connection. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: connect_google_business
title: Connect a Google Business Profile location
